summary: CPU saturation on the worker node caused by the shop-demo load generator; latency rose after replicas stayed at 1.

confirmed_facts.statement: Node CPU p95 stayed above 95% for 8 minutes.

alternative_hypotheses: Noisy neighbour pod on the same node.
missing_evidence: Per-pod CPU breakdown for the last 10 minutes.
limitations: Single node observed; no cross-node comparison.
